artifact_questions: What human outcome does this enable?
What causal path connects it to real capability?
compounding_test: Behavioral: a retained lesson matters when a later authorized Naya can retrieve it, recognize its applicability, use it, produce an outcome and have the outcome checked.
core_promise: Think once. Capture it. Learn from it. Remember it. Use it again. Get smarter.
deeper_problem: Continuity: useful context can disappear between conversations, agents and tools; NayaPOWER preserves useful context so a later Naya can reconstruct it and continue.
purpose: The WHY doctrine of the kernel: the purpose, the core promise, the continuity problem, the behavioral compounding test, and the three questions every artifact must answer.
purpose_statement: Increase human capability while reducing the need for humans to manage AI infrastructure.
title: KERNEL / WHY
